diff.intro: Argo CD itself computes the diff between git and the cluster, so it needs an API token (the account only needs the {code} permission on applications). Kubron can obtain a token from Argo CD itself or accept an existing one.
diff.storage: The token is stored only on this computer in a file with 0600 permissions, is never shown in the interface and does not end up in the audit log. Secret values in the diff are hidden.
diff.getToken: Get a token from Argo CD
diff.passwordNote: The password goes only to Argo CD through a local tunnel and is never stored; only the issued token is saved. A port forward to argocd-server will be opened.
diff.helpSummary: What to configure in Argo CD beforehand
diff.helpAccount: The account needs the {apiKey} capability, preferably a separate read-only account instead of {admin}:
diff.helpRbac: If the token is created by a user other than the token account, that user needs the {perm} permission. The same token can be created manually: {cmd}.
diff.noManage: A user with the "Manage clusters" permission can save the token.
diff.removeConfirm: Remove the saved Argo CD API token for this cluster?
diff.loadHint: Loading opens a tunnel to argocd-server (port forward) and requests the resource state from Argo CD.
